alex_chen: hey team, first day laptop question — trying to enroll my MBP into Kandji but the MDM enrollment keeps failing at the network step. getting a captive portal / cert error when connecting to corp-guest Wi‑Fi. any quick steps?

jamal_it: welcome alex! :wave: is this the office 802.1X wifi or a guest SSID? do you see any browser captive portal page or an SSL error?

alex_chen: it’s the office SSID (company-wifi). my mac shows ‘verification failed’ when Kandji tries to download the profile. browser shows a cert warning (NET::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID).

lena_security: don’t accept the cert in the browser yet — if it’s our internal CA we should get the CA cert deployed via MDM. can you paste the exact cert subject?

alex_chen: Subject: CN=Corp-Proxy-Intercept, O=CorpNet, C=US
Signature algorithm: sha256WithRSAEncryption

jamal_it: that’s our proxy cert. looks like the proxy is doing TLS interception. Kandji needs the root CA present in the System keychain BEFORE enrollment, otherwise profile download fails. two options: we can push the CA via Kandji (but enrollment is blocked until you’re enrolled), or we give you temporary admin to install the CA locally.

alex_chen: I don’t have admin creds. happy to do temp admin if security is ok.

priya_peopleops: Hi Alex — I can approve a 1-hour temp admin window. filing the access ticket now. @jamal_it please confirm the exact install steps so we can include them in the ticket. ticket: IT-TEMP-4721

jamal_it: thanks priya. instructions I’ll put in the ticket: 1) download CorpRootCA.pem from https://internal.corp/ca/CorpRootCA.pem 2) open Terminal and run: sudo security add-trusted-cert -d -r trustRoot -k /Library/Keychains/System.keychain ~/Downloads/CorpRootCA.pem 3) confirm in Keychain Access -> System -> Certificates -> CorpRootCA shows as trusted 4) re-run Kandji enrollment flow (Settings -> Profiles -> Enroll) 5) after success we’ll enable FileVault and then remove temp-admin.

lena_security: +1. also @alex_chen after enrollment please run a quick TLS check: curl -I https://kandji.com --cacert /Library/Keychains/System.keychain || curl without cert to confirm interception gone. (we can help interpret output)

it_bot: TEMP ADMIN GRANTED to alex_chen for 1 hour (expires in 60 minutes). Reference IT-TEMP-4721.

alex_chen: thanks all — installing now. pinging if anything breaks.

jamal_it: if sudo asks for a password, use the temp-admin one in the ticket. dm me if you get a ‘not allowed to add cert’ error.

alex_chen: installed the cert, Kandji enrollment succeeded, Device shows up in console. starting FileVault enable now. :tada:

lena_security: awesome. once FileVault finishes, we’ll verify escrow and rotate the machine into the prod policies. please confirm when Disk Encryption shows ‘On’ under Security & Privacy.

alex_chen: FileVault enabled and escrow key shows in the console. thanks everyone!

priya_peopleops: welcome aboard, Alex! adding a quick onboarding note to your new-hire checklist about Wi‑Fi certs. :sparkles:

jamal_it: closing ticket IT-TEMP-4721. removed temp-admin after confirmation. reach out if anything else crops up.
